title: Databricks SQL version 2026.38 is now available in Preview
body:
Databricks SQL version 2026.38 is now available in the **Preview** channel. Review the following section to learn about new features and improvements.

#### Truncate numbers without rounding using `truncate`

The `truncate` function truncates a number to a specified scale without rounding.

#### Remove array elements with `trim_array`

The `trim_array` function removes the specified number of elements from the end of an array.
